artifacts.summary: Seven-phase plan adding an evidence-gated inter-cycle redeploy checkpoint to skill-orchestrate Stage MT-3, with defer-remaining failure contract, fail-open deploy mutex, additive deliberate-invocation carve-out, and honest hazard-3 partial-retirement wording

memory_candidates.content: In skill-orchestrate's Stage MT-3 lifecycle-cycling loop, eligibility is recomputed from scratch every cycle, so any per-cycle exclusion decision re-fires forever unless it is also recorded in an INVOCATION-SCOPED deferral set on mt_state_file. deferred_self_modifying is the established template: the set is (1) checked in step 2's all-terminal test so a deferred task does not keep the loop alive, (2) subtracted in step 3's eligible_tasks build so the exclusion converges, (3) excluded from step 4's no-eligible circuit-breaker 'stuck tasks' framing, and (4) reported by Stage MT-5 as a category distinct from both completed_tasks and failed_tasks while forcing exit_status='partial'. Any NEW deferral cause must add its own named set rather than reusing deferred_self_modifying, because the operator remedy differs per cause; mirroring all four sites is the whole cost of adding one. Deferred tasks are never added to failed_tasks and never status-mutated -- deferral is 'incomplete by design', not 'broken'.
